text: SB 324 Passed → Address Confidentiality Program for survivors of stalking, domestic violence, and human trafficking. Helps the few hundred Georgians who enroll. Worthwhile. Narrow.

SB 531 Passed → DeKalb County School Board — salary raises. Raises pay for the school board members to $25,000/year — but failed to add any stipulations tying the raise to DeKalb school performance improvements.
SB 577 Passed → Streamlining waste removal fee collection from former tenants in DeKalb County. Helps DeKalb County collect more from former tenants. Doesn't lower your bill.
SB 75 Passed → Termination of residential lease for victims of stalking. Real protection for stalking victims who rent. Important — but a narrow slice of District 41.
SB 83 Passed → Stalking — eligibility for restraining orders, revised processes. Procedural improvement for the same small population as SB 75.
